audit_member_text: `BEDB` is allocated at L30 but never used; fixed axes are not derived from M,N,dx,dy.

base_member_text: mint labels (L21) are never used since nfile has one entry; the still-water extent [15.7 102.32] (L109) is hard-coded as in the multi_vessel script
audit_member_text: The script is structured for multiple `nfile` values (L41-L89), but ETA/BEDS/BB are overwritten on every iteration and the section statistics L92-L111 use only the final frame. `mint` has three entries at L21 while active nfile has one and is never used, indicating an incompletely reduced multi-frame version.

base_member_text: concentration is plotted in linear g/L with caxis [0 1.2] (L65-L66, L69) without the 2680*1000 conversion used in the multi_vessel sibling; whether the model's C output unit differs between cases or the label is inconsistent cannot be determined here
tight_subplot is an external dependency; second-figure axis limits [0 120 ...] (L105, L115) bound y although N=2n-1 rows imply y up to N-1 which may exceed 120

audit_member_text: Eta is masked to NaN before mirroring (L49,L53-L54), then rowwise `max`/`min` are called without `omitnan` at L97-L98. Any dry/masked cell in a row can make that row's extrema NaN rather than the wet-cell envelope, so the final red curves may disappear across rows containing shoreline masks.
Masking is applied to eta and concentration only (L49-L50), not `beds`; whether dry-cell DchgS values are valid is unstated. No shape checks precede mirroring assignments.
